title: ¿Por qué carajo no pasan los reportes? (Serie Sala de Juntas, idea P13-01)

ia.dice: ¡Asesores inmobiliarios! Les di doscientos leads esta semana. ¿Por qué carajo nadie me pasa el reporte?
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film, warm office lighting. Setting: a modern real estate agency meeting room with a glass wall, a long white table with laptops, coffee mugs and printed charts. At the head of the table stands Don Ramiro, a short chubby Mexican boss in his fifties with a thick black mustache, receding hairline, white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a loose red tie. His face turns red with anger, he slams both fists on the table so the mugs jump, and shouts at his sales agents in Mexican Spanish: "¡Asesores inmobiliarios! Les di doscientos leads esta semana. ¿Por qué carajo nadie me pasa el reporte?" Three real estate agents around the table flinch. Medium shot, slow push-in. Audio: only his angry voice in Spanish, fists on the table, mugs rattling. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Jefe, los leads los tengo anotados… en mi libreta. / Y yo los tengo en mi celular… creo.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film, warm office lighting. Setting: a modern real estate agency meeting room with a glass wall, a long white table with laptops, coffee mugs and printed charts. Diego, a skinny young real estate agent with glasses, slicked-back gelled hair and an oversized blue blazer, sweats nervously, holds up a small worn paper notebook and says in Mexican Spanish: "Jefe, los leads los tengo anotados… en mi libreta." Then Paola, a confident real estate agent with curly hair and a pink blouse, holds up her phone, shrugs and says: "Y yo los tengo en mi celular… creo." Awkward silence, crickets chirping. Medium two-shot, static camera. Audio: their voices in Spanish, then crickets. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Si en tu inmobiliaria cada asesor tiene los leads en su libreta o en su celular, el reporte nunca va a llegar.
Con Lead Master, todos los días te llega a tu WhatsApp qué pasó con cada lead: cuántos entraron, a quién llamó cada asesor inmobiliario, quién se quedó sin contacto y cuántas citas salieron.

alert.t: Nadie llenó nada: lo armó Lead Master con los chats y las llamadas

scenes.text: Si tienes una inmobiliaria con asesores, comenta SISTEMA y te lo instalamos. Sin que nadie llene nada.
